profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at SingleStore
profile.summary: I am a curious, passionate, and pragmatic engineer with strong computer science fundamentals and deep software systems understanding. I have 9 years of international experience in a wide variety of industries building real-world software in both high-growth start-ups and Fortune 500 companies. A high standard of quality, effective communication, and technical leadership are what set me apart.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: - Lead architect and developer for SingleStore Compute's Service (greenfield project) which powers all customer serverless workloads in Aura such as notebooks, scheduled jobs, python UDFs, dashboards, analyst, etc. Involved in all aspects of the system lifecycle: requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, security, reliability, scalability, monitoring and observability.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Role: Go Backend-Engineer

Impact:
- One of the main engineers responsible of designing, reviewing, implementing and rolling out the Workspaces project which effectively allowed the cloud service to evolve from a cluster-as-a-service platform to a serverless analytics platform.
- Developer productivity 2022 hackathon winner with the project "Improving the managed service backend logging and tracing"

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Role: Go Backend-Engineer

Main Responsibilities:
- Design, implement and support cloud service features that comply with the product requirements and can scale to support a production-level load.
- Provide help and guidance to team members of all levels of seniority.
- Perform valuable code reviews and enforce best practices and team conventions.
- Technologies used: Go, GraphQL, AWS, Azure, GCP, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, K3s

Impact:
- Introduced a brand new service (Temporal) which is currently used in production and running thousands of workflows concurrently.
- Completely owned several features and took them from design to production including the Managed Service Editions.
- Trained and mentored team members with various levels of seniority. 
- Key member for defining code and architectural best practices.
- Diagnosed, debugged and fixed several critical bugs that impacted our production service. 
- In a very short time I have become the expert in many sections of the codebase and I posess a very good understanding of the majority of the codebase.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Role: Back-end Software Engineer/Technical Lead/Solutions Architect.

Main Responsibilities:
- Technical leader of an 8 member engineering team in charge of designing, developing, integrating, testing and releasing a Shopify web app that allows shop owners to get additional revenue by showing relevant offerings on their site. Tech Stack: Typescript, Koa, React, AWS, Redis, Docker, Buildkite
- Technical mentor of a 10 member engineering team focused on Cloud Native technologies. Tech Stack:  AWS, GCP, Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, Istio, Spring Cloud, Netflix OSS, Serverless Framework
- Principal engineer in charge of developing, configuring, testing and releasing a business process engine that will impact millions of users. Tech Stack: Java, Spring Boot, AWS, MySQL, Docker, Jenkins

Additional roles:
- Solutions Architect/Consultant: Traveled on-site as part of a 4 person team whose goal was to transform business requirements into technical requirements before projects kicked-off
- Mentor on Software Architecture, Git, CI/CD, Containerization and Cloud Native related topics
- Interviewer on all stages of the recruitment process for software engineers

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Role: Back-end Software Engineer/Technical Lead/Solutions Architect.

Main Responsibilities:
- Technical leader of an 8 member engineering team in charge of designing, developing, integrating and testing a video Digital Rights Management system. Tech Stack: C++, Java, Python, Swift, AWS, CircleCI
- Back-end software engineer: Designed, developed and tested a scheduling system for a FinTech web app. Tech stack: Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, JUnit5

Additional Roles:
- Solutions Architect/Consultant: Traveled on-site as part of a 4 person team whose goal was to transform business requirements into technical requirements before projects kicked-off
- Interviewer on all stages of the recruitment process for software engineers

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Role: QA Engineer

Main responsibilities:
- Completely owned testing of several components and processes in Oracle's Big Data Appliance, including cluster virtualization, OS image building, BDA software installation, configuration and upgrade, network firewall and Hadoop high availability. Tech stack: Bash, Python, Hadoop, HDFS
- Became the principal project's virtualization platform administrator which was scaled to serve a large team of engineers across the world. Tech Stack: Bash, Python, Oracle Virtual Machine Manager
- Executed troubleshooting and sysadmin tasks on a variety of Linux servers and VMs. Tech stack: Bash

Additional Roles:
- Interviewer for the QA engineer position

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Role: Embedded Software Test Engineer

Main Responsibilities:
- Designed and executed integration tests for the Advanced Power Management System project. Tech stack: C
- Analyzed and reviewed low-level and high-level software and system requirements.
- Developed internal tools for engineering processes automation. Tech stack: Bash, Perl, C# and Visual Basic

Accomplishments:
- Became one of the principal test procedure reviewers of the AMPS project
- Earned a Six Sigma Green Belt certification for writing scripts and tools that boosted developer productivity measured in the thousands of hours a year. Tech Stack: Perl, Visual Basic

positions.title: Software Intern
positions.description:
Role: Engineering Software Tools Developer

Main Responsibilities:
- Develop internal engineering software tools for the GEnx controls team. Tech stack: Bash, Perl and Visual Basic

Accomplishments:
- Significantly increased the control systems team productivity by creating diverse software tools and applications

positions.title: Lean Challenge 2013 intern
positions.description:
- Represented my university on the 'Lean Challenge' regional contest and obtained the 2nd place.
- Responsible for implementing a Lean Six Sigma simplification project for a mechanical engineering and design team using VBA and obtaining important savings.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
- Succesfully completed the 'Instrumentation software for a phonocardiogram' project adviced by Dr. Moisés Cywiak Garbarcewics. Tech stack: C
- Presented the project's results on the 14th Science Summer Conference.
